shapePosterior.classification: Conditional triaxial ellipsoid fit, not resolved terrain or an adopted digital shape
shapePosterior.limits: Section IV explicitly identifies a/b/c as semi-axes although Table 3 labels them axes. Medians and 16th/84th percentiles are not independent Gaussian errors. Pole uses assumed spin/orbit alignment and propagated precession; no current fixed orientation, local normal or body-map registration.

occultationMethod.fit: occult3d/emcee eight free parameters: three semi-axes, two pole coordinates, phase and two ephemeris offsets; lightcurve/pole Gaussian priors. Not independently reproduced.
occultationMethod.excludedChord: RECON24 omitted as discrepant with a more precise nearby chord. Exclusion retained, not silently restored.
occultationMethod.errorFloor: LDT timing-only 0.002 second/~50 m endpoint estimate is publisher supplied. Added 5 km in quadrature models possible departures from triaxiality; it is not a measured terrain height or a new raster/angular calculation.
occultationMethod.selection: Station positions and immersion/emersion timings unavailable in the cited preliminary reports. Authors propagated trial shapes using assumed synchronous phase and limb lengths, omitted shadow-path geometry and rejected samples with combined probability below 1%; about 70% removed and June fit chi-square increased 0.6. This is not a direct full fit of those events or independent coverage validation.
occultationMethod.referenceOffsets: Table 3 f=-58±3 km, g=53(+8,-9) km relative to the specified Proudfoot Weywot and NIMAv20 Quaoar ephemerides; not a correction adopted in Fidelity.

photometricFitLimits: Nine accepted points/four degrees of freedom: preferred symmetric fit reported chi-square per degree of freedom 3.42.
Asymmetric model leaves two degrees of freedom and is unconstrained/overfit; fine-tuned zero-mean asymmetry prior width .01 produces .77, still described as overfitting.
Table 2 phase 111.4(+7.6,-6.7) degrees versus Table 3 phase 24±8 degrees requires an explicit convention crosswalk; neither initializes scene orientation.
F606W and V absolute magnitudes below the Table 2 rule are derived; source calibration and filter transfer require the unresolved Appendix D audit. No calibrated albedo/colour adopted.
sourceConsistencyQuestions: Versioned TeX as well as HTML prints F606W zeropoint 25.995 in Section II.2.4 and 29.995 in Appendix D. Preserve both; cause/authoritative correction open.
Appendix D ratio direction and subsequent V-flux conversion require source/PDF/algebra verification. No repaired calibration implemented.
Appendix B synodic-offset formula and numerical offsets have not been independently reproduced.
Table 1 light-time-corrected midpoints differ in convention from Appendix A uncorrected geocentric midpoints; neither is silently relabelled individual raw exposure UTC.
